before: **Transition band.** Normal wage tax by the ELStAM. Contributions are worked out on reduced bases by two formulas in [§ 20(2a) SGB IV](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/sgb_4/__20.html), with AE the monthly pay, G = EUR 603 and F = 0.6619. Base for the total contribution: BE = F x G + (2,000 / (2,000 - G) - G / (2,000 - G) x F) x (AE - G). Base for the employee's share: BE = 2,000 / (2,000 - G) x (AE - G). The employee pays the employee rates on the second base; the employer pays the total contribution on the first base less the employee's share. At AE EUR 1,000 the bases are EUR 854.06 and EUR 568.36. Not for apprentices. Exactly EUR 2,000 is still in the band ("nicht übersteigen").
after: **Transition band.** Normal wage tax by the ELStAM. Contributions are worked out on reduced bases by two formulas in [§ 20(2a) SGB IV](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/sgb_4/__20.html), with AE the monthly pay, G = EUR 603 and F = 0.6619. Base for the total contribution: BE = F x G + (2,000 / (2,000 - G) - G / (2,000 - G) x F) x (AE - G). Base for the employee's share: BE = 2,000 / (2,000 - G) x (AE - G). For the ordinarily shared branches outside Saxony, compute the total contribution by applying half the contribution rate to the first base, rounding to cents and doubling; compute the employee's ordinary half-rate contribution on the second base, rounding to cents. The employer bears the difference. Calculate the employee-only childless care surcharge on the first base; calculate care reductions on the second base, each rounded separately ([§ 1(2) and § 2(2) BVV](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/beitrvv/__2.html)). At AE EUR 1,000 the 0.6-point childless surcharge is EUR 5.12, not EUR 3.41. Saxony has a separate allocation under § 58(5) SGB XI; this ordinary half-rate worksheet does not supply that Saxony allocation. At AE EUR 1,000 the bases are EUR 854.06 and EUR 568.36. Not for apprentices. Exactly EUR 2,000 is still in the band ("nicht übersteigen").
